items.claim: Muhammad Said relies heavily on kicks, with an estimated 80 percent of his strikes being kicks.
items.quote: 80% of his strikes are kicks. He's power kicking.

items.claim: Muhammad Said does not offer offensive takedowns but possesses solid takedown defense using whizzer defense and hip tosses.
items.quote: You're not going to see any offensive takedowns from him, but his takedown defense is solid.

items.claim: Dustin Jacoby is the more technical striker with better footwork and range management.
items.quote: I think Dustin's just more technical. I think he's got the better footwork, probably the better range management.

items.claim: Muhammad Said holds a significant age advantage, being eight years younger than Dustin Jacoby.
items.quote: eight years younger to be exact.

items.claim: Volkanovski Walker is on a four-fight win streak with all four wins coming by heel hook.
items.quote: All four of his last fights are wins. All four of those wins are by heel hook.

items.claim: Volkanovski Walker has undergone a complete physical transformation since his early fights.
